assign.request: spawn some minions to analyze the thoroughness and simplicity of our styles, UI, layouts, etc. we need to greatly simplify our framework. I'm not sure the best way to do that.
steps: CSS vocabulary census (words, sizes, live usage)

assign.now: census done (51 framework words, 28 site words); reading prior audit tier

log.msg: census v2: framework.css defines 51 class words, styles.css 28. 6 words have <=1 live use outside doc pages. Only 2 !important in 126 css files - the layer system is working.

assign.now: overlap map in from 2 agents; writing the proposal

log.msg: the bloat is NOT the utility vocabulary. framework/ excl ai/: 3821 KB markdown in 1139 files vs 3480 KB js in 810 files vs 472 KB css. core/new alone = 445 files, 308 page.js, 30608 js loc = 81 pct of core js.

assign.outcome:
**The styles are not the problem.** The whole utility vocabulary is 6.8 KB; the framework carries **4,887 KB of prose against 2,860 KB of code (63%)**. Any plan that starts with the CSS is optimising 0.3% of the bytes.

- [**proposal.md**](/framework/ai/2026-08-30/simplify-audit/proposal.md) - 9 ranked items (value / risk), a do-not-touch list, and the three moves to make first.
- [census.json](/framework/ai/2026-08-30/simplify-audit/census.json) - all 79 class words (51 framework.css + 28 styles.css) with layer, definition bytes, and live application counts.

**Census:** 51 words in framework.css, 6,838 bytes total. 10 words carry 79% of all use. 15 words have <= 2 live applications = 1,413 bytes = 0.3% of the CSS budget. Three zoom rungs (75/175/200) have ZERO call sites, against a framework.css comment that claims eight of nine are used. Four words (app, md, grid, flow) are defined TWICE, in two files, two layers, with no cross-reference.

**Cascade health:** **zero !important in 94 stylesheets.** Two files hold the word, both inside a comment saying one was not needed. The cost is paid in prose instead: 32 specificity mentions across 17 doc/decisions.md.

**Overlap map:** Panel 4,483 LOC / 75 KB CSS / 4 real callers. Playground 1,623 LOC / 0 importers - NOT a subset of Panel (zero shared code, different mechanism); the one true duplicate is the hug/fill/fixed model, coded twice. DesignTool 5,635 LOC. Those three are 55% of ext JS and none is a site part. Sticky-rail CSS still duplicated 4x (two auditors found it in August; still open). blogx rail (0 callers, 22 KB) reinvents catalog (25 callers). decks: 0 callers, 16 KB.

**The three moves:** (1) delete core/new/0 and core/new/starter - **445 files, 2.8 MB, 308 of the framework 533 page.js, 81% of core JS**, zero importers by rule, already read and cleared by the 2026-08-15 audit. (2) The 17 demo height clips - an afternoon, already scoped, the only defect a visitor sees. (3) Take doc/file/*.md to the owner: **371 files, 734 KB, 19% of all framework markdown**, and nobody has ever asked if it earns its keep.

**Left:** zero framework edits, by fence. Every item is a recommendation for the owner and the mastermind to rank.
